company.shortDescription: Microverse is an online school for remote software developers that costs nothing until getting the job.
company.description:
Microverse is an online school for remote software developers. Microverse's mission is to educate and connect 1 million people with remote opportunities by 2030. 

At Microverse, students from all around the world work in small distributed teams while doing remote pair programming. They hold each other accountable and learn together while working on open source and freelance projects.

insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $5,585,242 to $69,864,463, a 12.51x increase.

caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
